title: Introducing docs.sailscasts.com
summary: The vision of Sailscasts is to empower anyone with a basic idea of JavaScript to build fullstack Node.js applications. With the new docs we hope to provide great documentation for the technologies we build to foster this vision
body_markdown:
Super excited to announce the all new[docs.sailscast.com](https://docs.sailscasts.com/) - a central documentation for the Sailscasts ecosystem of open source and paid software.


This new docs is powered by[Vitepress](https://vitepress.vuejs.org/) and its open source so anyone can contribute to all the docs.


Happy reading
